title: The first software-engineering number this project has ever produced
the_question: 'you sure this is the smartest approach?' (seventh time)
the_answer: no -- and the failure was visible in the conversation, not the code: seven reframings, zero runs. This round contains no new method. It contains the run.

the_gate_that_had_to_pass_first.rule: r90 -- no foreign model inside the measurement
the_gate_that_had_to_pass_first.audit: multistep_repo_closed_loop_solver_v1 imports ast, copy, difflib, hashlib, itertools, json, math, os, pathlib, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, typing + three canonical.swe_kernel modules. ZERO network calls, ZERO LLM, ZERO api key.
the_gate_that_had_to_pass_first.verdict: PASSES the r90 gate -- any result it produces is the model's, not the agent's

the_measurement.method: copy the live repo, inject a real defect into a real source file, confirm the repo's own pytest suite goes RED, hand the solver nothing but the repo root and the test file, then re-run the suite
the_measurement.oracle: the repository's own test suite -- not a proxy, not a rubric

case_2.defect: pg_multiset_dedup: weakened a dedup guard (not a wrong-but-valid defect)
case_2.reading: the solver CORRECTLY refused to claim a repair it had not made; the defect was mine, not the solver's

the_number: 0 / 1 on sealed single-file defects, with the suite red before and red after

what_is_real_in_that_zero.it_is_the_first_one: 95 rounds of computer-use measurements, zero software-engineering measurements. This is the first number on the conjunctive half of the stated goal.
what_is_real_in_that_zero.the_instrument_works: the solver ran, localised, attempted, failed and FAILED CLOSED with a named status. It did not falsely claim success. A zero-credit zero is worth more than an uncredited pass.
what_is_real_in_that_zero.the_oracle_is_real: the repository's own test suite, red before and red after. No rubric, no judge, no model.
what_is_real_in_that_zero.the_r90_gate_passes: no external model was inside the measurement.

what_is_not_real.not_a_pass: 0/1 is a failure rate of 1.0 on this defect class.
what_is_not_real.not_a_software_engineering_capability: the closed-loop solver cannot repair a defect in a 90-line module when given its own failing test. That is the floor of the task, not the ceiling.
what_is_not_real.not_general: one injected defect of one kind (a short-circuit). No claim is made about other defect classes.

the_honest_comparison.this_system: 0/1 on a defect 30x easier than an SWE-bench task, in a file the system shipped itself
the_honest_comparison.reading: the distance is not a matter of tuning the closed loop. It is the absence of anything that can read a failing assertion and construct the inverse edit.

the_lesson.statement: seven rounds of 'am I sure?' were answered with seven better methods and zero runs. The correct response to the seventh was to stop producing methods. A number from a failing instrument is worth more than a plan from a perfect one.
the_lesson.law: r96 -- a round that produces no execution is not a round. Governance records are not a substitute for a run.
